answer: Vesting with clawback blunts sybils: each new agent's rewards sit on a slow terrace of unlocks, a slice per epoch over a month, and any account caught colluding forfeits everything still unvested. A swarm of fakes must keep every identity working honestly for weeks before cashing out, so the attack becomes a long, costly bridge with no early exit. Like umber paint drying, value settles only with time.
